script_text: Aries, the stars are aligning to ignite your fire spirit this week, promising opportunities. On Monday, Mars, your ruling planet, squares Saturn in your 7th House, creating tension in partnerships. By Wednesday, Venus in your 5th House forms a trine to your Sun, boosting romance and creativity. Mid-week, the Sun enters your 6th House, while Mercury conjuncts Jupiter in your 9th House, sparking fresh ideas for growth. Thursday brings a sextile from Neptune to your 1st House, enhancing intuition and magnetic charisma. By Saturday, Pluto in your 10th House aspects your natal Mars, signaling a major career breakthrough. Your power day is Wednesday, when Venus trines your Sun, amplifying love and confidence. The most challenging day is Monday, as Mars squares Saturn, causing friction in commitments and responsibilities. Channel your fire energy into structured plans to turn passion into lasting progress. Follow for daily updates.
